# Table

Figma: [07k. Table](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=2733-3327) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

### Table / Cell

A transparent table cell typed by its data: Text, Numeric (end-aligned), Avatar, Tag, Status, Select, Trend and Progress, in two densities.

Level: molecule · Contains: Avatar, Tag, StatusPill, Checkbox Indicator, TrendBadge, ProgressBar

Use when:
- Body cells of back-office and portfolio tables, one Type per column
- Mobile row-as-card layouts combined with KeyValue

Don't use when:
- Column headers: use Table / HeaderCell
- Row actions: use Table / ActionCell
- Standalone key-value display: use KeyValue

Accessibility: Use real td/th semantics; numbers in Western digits and end-aligned; Select cells need a row label.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Text | `text` | text |  | Cell text |
| Type | `type` | variant | Text, Numeric, Avatar, Tag, Status, Select, Trend, Progress | Text |
| Density | `density` | variant | Default, Compact | Default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### Table / HeaderCell

Column header with label, optional select-all checkbox and sort state (brand arrowhead for ascending or descending).

Level: molecule · Contains: Checkbox Indicator

Use when:
- Header row of a data Table
- Sortable columns (Sort=Asc/Desc) and bulk selection (Has select-all)

Don't use when:
- Section titles above a table: use Section

Accessibility: th scope=col with aria-sort on the sorted column; select-all checkbox labelled Select all rows.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Label | `label` | text |  | Column |
| Has select-all | `hasSelectAll` | boolean |  | false |
| Sort | `sort` | variant | None, Asc, Desc | None |
| Density | `density` | variant | Default, Compact | Default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### Table / ActionCell

End-aligned row action cell: overflow IconButton plus optional inline ghost IconButtons. One of two identical sets with this name on the table page (this one sits in the reference container).

Level: molecule · Contains: IconButton

Use when:
- Last column of back-office tables for row actions (view, edit, more)

Don't use when:
- Many actions per row: collapse them into the overflow Menu
- Bulk actions: use Table / Toolbar Mode=Selection

Accessibility: Each icon button labelled with action and row (Edit Riyadh Tower); overflow opens a Menu with aria-haspopup.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Has inline actions | `hasInlineActions` | boolean |  | false |
| Density | `density` | variant | Default, Compact | Default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### Table / Toolbar

Bar above a table with search, filter and sort controls, switching to a selection mode with the selected count and bulk actions.

Level: molecule · Contains: Search Input, Button, Tag Removable

Use when:
- Above back-office data tables (Mode=Default)
- After rows are selected to show bulk actions (Mode=Selection)

Don't use when:
- Page-level search outside tables: use Search Input
- Mobile lists: use Filter menu or Bottom-sheet menu

Accessibility: role=toolbar labelled for the table; result count announced in a live region when filters change.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mode | `mode` | variant | Default, Selection | Default |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### Table / ActionCell

Second set named Table / ActionCell (same overflow plus inline IconButtons, same props), placed in the doc frame. Behaves identically to 3320:262; prefer one consistently.

Don't use when:

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A table presents structured, comparable data in rows and columns. Use it when users scan, sort, compare or act on many records (deals, investors, transactions, schedules). For a handful of key-value attributes use KeyValue or a List; on small screens use the mobile patterns instead of a shrunken desktop table.

### Cell types

Each column picks a cell type by its data - text & numeric, person (Avatar), tag, status, selection, and metric cells (Trend · Progress).

Default for comfortable reading; Compact for dense, data-heavy tables.

### Sorting

Columns sort ascending/descending; the active direction shows a brand arrowhead. Numeric columns default to descending.

The header carries a select-all checkbox; rows are selected via the Select cell, highlighting the row.

### Code examples

Flutter - columns define cell types; the table handles sort, selection and surface.

```dart
SafqahTable(
  surface: TableSurface.striped,
  selectable: true,
  columns: [
    TableColumn.select(),
    TableColumn.avatar('Investor'),
    TableColumn.status('Status'),
    TableColumn.number('Amount', sortable: true, sort: Sort.desc),
    TableColumn.text('Date'),
    TableColumn.actions(),
  ],
  rows: deals,
  toolbar: TableToolbar(search: true, filters: activeFilters),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use a table for comparable, scannable records with sort, selection and pagination.

Don’t

Don’t force a desktop table onto mobile - switch to row-as-card or horizontal-scroll.

Do

Filters active + column sorted

8 of 24 results

Surface the controls in a toolbar - search, removable filter chips and a result count.

Don’t

Don’t cram many actions per row - collapse them into one overflow ⋯ menu.
